messages:
maggie.marketing: Hi all—new launch blog draft v1.4 up: https://docs.google.com/example/launch-v1.4 Need quick copy pass + legal + CTA/UTM confirmation so we can queue publish and webinar invites.

sam.copy: on it. Top-level edit: shorten hero to one sentence and move the customer quote up.

maggie.marketing: agree, one-line hero + 2-line kicker. Sam, trim and push by noon.

devon.growth: CTA tiers: 'Start hosted trial', 'Request dedicated trial', 'Book enterprise pilot'. Proposed utm_content: hosted_trial, dedicated_trial, enterprise_pilot.

nate.ops: utm pattern looks good. I'll map CRM tags: blog_launch_mql and blog_launch_enterprise once UTMs final.

elaine.legal: quick review—remove comparative phrasing like 'best in class' and add KMS/HSM + configurable retention in Data Controls. After that minor edit I can approve.

sam.copy: removed superlatives, added: "optional customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and configurable retention policies."

alex.events: webinar tentative: Tue 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC. Recommend 12 demo slots post-webinar and waitlist form. Draft calendar blurb: "Launch + live demo: 30-min product walkthrough + Q&A."

devon.growth: Sales request: tag anyone clicking enterprise_pilot and visiting /pricing as PQL. Nate can we add that rule?

nate.ops: yep—will add pixel and workflow: visit_pricing && utm_content=enterprise_pilot => tag: blog_launch_enterprise + assign AE.

maggie.marketing: timeline: Sam final by 12:00 UTC, Elaine legal by 14:00, Devon confirms UTMs by 15:00, Alex locks invites. Embargo lift scheduled 2026-05-10 09:00 UTC. Publish-bot will remind.

publish-bot: Reminder: embargo set for 2026-05-10 09:00 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: when final approved.

maggie.marketing: thanks—I'll post final link once Sam finishes edits.
